pop-golden-hour.title: Golden Hour Drive
pop-golden-hour.lyrics:
[Verse]
Key in the ignition, let it hum
Watching the heat rise off the drum
Tank is full and my head is light
Left the heavy world back at the light
One hand on the wheel, one on the air
Counting all the ways that I don’t care
Everything I needed was right here
In the rear view as it starts to clear

[Chorus]
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Just a long road and a radio song
This is where I truly belong
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Wild and wide, the day is new
I’m in love with the view

[Verse]
Orange honey dripping down the trees
I can taste the salt inside the breeze
Past the pines and the roadside stands
Life is finally back in my own hands
No more schedules or the busy talk
No more watching every tick of the clock
Just the tires spinning on the blacktop
Hope this feeling never has to stop

[Chorus]
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Just a long road and a radio song
This is where I truly belong
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Wild and wide, the day is new
I’m in love with the view

[Bridge]
Maybe I’ll just keep on driving south
With a smile right across my mouth
Sun is sinking but I’m rising up
Drinking every drop from a heavy cup

[Chorus]
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Just a long road and a radio song
This is where I truly belong
Amber light is washing over me
Windows down, I’m finally feeling free
Wild and wide, the day is new
I’m in love with the view

[Outro]

rnb-slow-dance.title: Midnight Kitchen
rnb-slow-dance.lyrics:
[Verse]
The coffee pot is cold on the counter
The fridge is humming a low-key blues
We left the dishes for tomorrow morning
Right now I’ve got nothing to lose
Just your hands resting on my waist
Moving slow to a song in my head
The moon is leaking through the blinds
Painting stripes across the floor instead

[Chorus]
We’re dancing in the dark
Spinning on the linoleum tiles
Midnight in the kitchen
I could stay right here for miles
We’re dancing in the dark
Holding on like the world might end
Midnight in the kitchen
My lover and my truest friend

[Verse]
I kicked my shoes off by the pantry door
You’re humming something sweet and low
The way the yellow light hits your eyes
Is the only thing I need to know
Forget about the plans we made
Forget about the clock on the wall
In this square of tile and shadow
I’m not afraid to let myself fall

[Chorus]
We’re dancing in the dark
Spinning on the linoleum tiles
Midnight in the kitchen
I could stay right here for miles
We’re dancing in the dark
Holding on like the world might end
Midnight in the kitchen
My lover and my truest friend

[Bridge]
No fancy lights or crowded rooms
No tuxedo or a silk lace gown
Just the smell of tea and lavender
While the rest of the neighborhood sleeps sound
I don't need a stage to find my grace
Long as I’m looking at your face

[Chorus]
We’re dancing in the dark
Spinning on the linoleum tiles
Midnight in the kitchen
I could stay right here for miles
We’re dancing in the dark
Holding on like the world might end
Midnight in the kitchen
My lover and my truest friend

[Outro]

latin-verano.title: Noche de sal y arena
latin-verano.lyrics:
[Verse]
La arena todavía quema los pies
Siento el salitre rozando mi piel
Busco tu sombra en la oscuridad
Donde las olas vienen y se van

[Verse]
Suena un piano a lo lejos del bar
Bajo la luna frente al inmenso mar
No importa el tiempo ni qué pasará
Solo este instante nos va a liberar

[Chorus]
Baila conmigo toda la noche
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul
Siente el deseo en el aire
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul

[Verse]
Tus ojos brillan con luz de coral
Todo se vuelve tan espiritual
Movemos el cuerpo sin una razón
Siguiendo el latido de un solo tambor

[Chorus]
Baila conmigo toda la noche
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul
Siente el deseo en el aire
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul

[Chorus]
Baila conmigo toda la noche
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul
Siente el deseo en el aire
Baila conmigo bajo el cielo azul

[Outro]

reggae-island-time.title: Island Time
reggae-island-time.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sun kicks the dust up on the porch,
I’m kicking off my boots.
The coconut trees are swaying slow,
Like they’re pulling at their roots.
Got the radio on a low-fi hum,
No need to rush the day.
When the tide comes in, let it take its time,
While we wash the world away.

[Chorus]
We’re on island time,
Just living for the easy.
Everything’s fine,
So breezy.
We’re on island time,
No clock upon the wall.
Everything’s fine,
The world can wait it all.

[Verse]
Brother’s got the grill going out back,
Sweet smoke up in the air.
Stories told for the hundredth time,
And nobody seems to care.
Pass the bottle, keep the circle tight,
No stress inside the frame.
When you’re drifting on a sea of calm,
Every day feels just the same.

[Chorus]
We’re on island time,
Just living for the easy.
Everything’s fine,
So breezy.
We’re on island time,
No clock upon the wall.
Everything’s fine,
The world can wait it all.

[Bridge]
The shadows stretch across the sand,
The stars begin to wake.
There’s a peace in doing nothing much,
For the quiet spirit’s sake.

[Chorus]
We’re on island time,
Just living for the easy.
Everything’s fine,
So breezy.
We’re on island time,
No clock upon the wall.
Everything’s fine,
The world can wait it all.

[Outro]
Just let it wait.
Take it slow now.
No worries today.
Island time.

[Outro]

country-front-porch.title: Front Porch Fireflies
country-front-porch.lyrics:
[Verse]
The screen door creaks a familiar tune,
As the sun dips low in the afternoon.
Grandpa’s rocking chair beats the floor,
While the kids play tag by the cellar door.

[Chorus]
Pass the sweet tea round,
Watch the stars touch the ground.
Summer evenings on the porch,
Summer evenings on the porch.

[Verse]
Mama’s got a glass with a lemon slice,
Telling stories twice about the quiet life.
Neon green flickers in the tall fescue,
Small wonders dancing in the mountain dew.

[Chorus]
Pass the sweet tea round,
Watch the stars touch the ground.
Summer evenings on the porch,
Summer evenings on the porch.

[Verse]
There’s a comfort here in the fading light,
Tucking all our worries in for the night.
Ice cubes clinking against the jar,
Knowing exactly where and who we are.

[Chorus]
Pass the sweet tea round,
Watch the stars touch the ground.
Summer evenings on the porch,
Summer evenings on the porch.

[Outro]

indie-paper-planes.title: Paper Planes from the Rooftop
indie-paper-planes.lyrics:
[Verse]
The gravel crunching under worn-out soles
We climbed the ladder to the water tank
A pack of cigarettes we barely smoked
And all the heavy secrets that we drank
The air was thin and smelled of coming rain
We didn't care about the drive back home
Just five kids playing at a bigger game
Kings of a castle made of brick and stone

[Chorus]
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew
Paper planes
Higher than the birds and rain
Paper planes
Sending out our younger names
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew

[Verse]
You had a map drawn on a napkin edge
I had a pocket full of loose change
We made a promise on that narrow ledge
Before the map began to look so strange
Now you're in Denver with a steady job
And I’m still tracing lines upon the floor
Funny how the time can try to rob
The things we didn't think were worth much more

[Chorus]
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew
Paper planes
Higher than the birds and rain
Paper planes
Sending out our younger names
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew

[Bridge]
They never landed where we thought they would
Stuck in the gutters or the power lines
But looking back I think we understood
The launch was always better than the finds

[Chorus]
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew
Paper planes
Higher than the birds and rain
Paper planes
Sending out our younger names
White wings against the blue
Folding up the years we knew

[Outro]
Watch them go
Watch them go
Folding up the years we knew
Higher than the rain

[Outro]

blues-midnight-train.title: The Midnight Train Still Comes
blues-midnight-train.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Slow blues guitar lick, heavy distortion, sliding notes]

[Verse]
The landlord took the key at half-past ten.
Said don't you bother coming back again.
My suitcase handle’s held with packing tape.
Looking for a way to make a clean escape.

[Chorus]
Waiting for the midnight train.
Washing off the dirt and the pain.
Lost my house and my pride.
But I’m still standing inside.
Waiting for the midnight train.

[Verse]
Pockets feel light, just a dime and a prayer.
Cold wind blowing through my thinning hair.
The platform’s empty and the lights are low.
Got a long, long way left for me to go.

[Chorus]
Waiting for the midnight train.
Washing off the dirt and the pain.
Lost my house and my pride.
But I’m still standing inside.
Waiting for the midnight train.

[Bridge]
They say the sun don’t shine on a man who’s down.
But I’m leaving all my troubles in this town.
I hear the whistle blowing miles away.
Gonna find myself a brand new day.

[Chorus]
Waiting for the midnight train.
Washing off the dirt and the pain.
Lost my house and my pride.
But I’m still standing inside.
Waiting for the midnight train.

[Outro]
Yeah, she’s coming down the track.
And I ain't never looking back.
[Fade out with harmonica solo]

[Outro]

metal-iron-sky.title: Standing Strong
metal-iron-sky.lyrics:
[Verse]
Clouds are heavy with a leaden weight
The sky is turning black as slate
Let the thunder roll across the plain
I’m standing ready for the rain

[Chorus]
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break

[Verse]
Lightning scars the surface of the dark
But it cannot kill this living spark
Gales are howling, trying to take hold
My roots are deep, my heart is bold

[Chorus]
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break

[Breakdown]
Let it crash
Let it roar
I’ve seen this all before
Strike me down
Try your best
I’ll survive the final test

[Chorus]
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break
The world is shaking under my feet
I will not bow, I won't retreat
Still I stand
I will not break

[Outro]

punk-no-sleep.title: No Sleep Til Stage
punk-no-sleep.lyrics:
[Verse]
Clock on the wall says half past three
Coffee in a cup, eyes on the screen
Gears in the van, we’re ready to roll
Fuel for the heart, noise for the soul
The highway is calling, the sun’s going down
We’re leaving the quiet, we’re waking the town
Four strings, six strings, one beat, one sound
Let's drive 'til our feet don't touch the ground

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead
Sleep is for the dead
Get it through your head
Five states, three nights, one dirty floor
We’re kicking down every locked door
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead

[Verse]
Red Bull and water, a bag of cheap chips
The smell of the stage, the salt on my lips
No money for hotels, we crash in the seats
Hearing the ringing from amps in our dreams
But nobody’s dreaming, we’re wide awake
Counting the seconds for the big break
Check the levels, plug in the cord
This is the only thing we afford

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead
Sleep is for the dead
Get it through your head
Five states, three nights, one dirty floor
We’re kicking down every locked door
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead

[Bridge]
My voice is cracking, my hands are sore
The crowd is screaming, they want one more
We’re exhausted, we’re frantic, we’re wired
But we’ve never felt less tired
Pass the mic, hit the snare
The morning light is almost there

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead
Sleep is for the dead
Get it through your head
Five states, three nights, one dirty floor
We’re kicking down every locked door
Sleep is for the dead
Play it loud instead

[Outro]
